collection_methods.primary: Elsevier Scopus Search API (X-ELS-APIKey) - query=ISSN(0144-8617), sort=-coverDate, 33 pages x 25 = 825 entries scanned (start=0..824). content/search/scidir endpoint confirmed HTTP 410 Gone (retired) as in prior runs; content/search/scopus used instead. API key has metadata-only entitlement (no abstract/full-text access via content/abstract/pii).
collection_methods.abstract_supplement: WebSearch was used per-article for all 25 qualifying articles (not just the focus-keyword subset) to gather context on methodology/results from ScienceDirect/ResearchGate/PubMed/Google Scholar snippets. ScienceDirect direct WebFetch returned HTTP 403 (bot-blocked) as expected; WebSearch used as fallback per task instructions. Korean descriptions in the report were newly composed from this gathered context, not copied or translated verbatim from English abstracts.
collection_methods.author_enrichment: CrossRef API (api.crossref.org/works/{doi}) used for full author lists for all 25 qualifying articles.
collection_methods.eligibility_filtering: Scopus subtypeDescription=='Article' kept (Review/Erratum/Editorial excluded at source). Additional title-pattern screen removed further review-style titles (patterns: review, recent advances, future perspectives, bridging, strategies mechanisms, design principles, comprehensive review, progress on/in, overview). 8 microbe-strain-biology-centric papers excluded where the core topic was microbial genetics/strain engineering/biosynthesis-pathway elucidation rather than the polysaccharide material itself (genetic/bioprocess engineering for microbial alginate production; halophile fungal cell wall biology via solid-state NMR; metabolic network and biosynthesis of exopolysaccharide in Bacillus smithii; PilZ domain mutations in bacterial glucan synthases; E. coli strain engineering for O-polysaccharide vaccine biosynthesis; polysaccharide-localization switching mechanism in lactobacilli; Corynebacterium glutamicum strain engineering for chondroitin production; bacterial cellulose biosynthesis/regulation mechanism review-style article). Polysaccharide-structure/material-focused papers involving microbial sources were retained when the material itself, not organism biology, was the stated focus (e.g., Lactiplantibacillus-derived galactoglucan structural characterization was NOT included in this batch but would qualify under this rule; none of the 25 selected are microbially-sourced in this run).
collection_methods.dedup_crosscheck: PII/DOI cross-checked against state/seen_articles.json (1009 prior entries) to exclude already-covered articles.
collection_methods.note_on_search_dynamics: The most recent coverDate window (2026-08-01 to 2026-10-01) was dominated almost entirely by Review-type and Erratum entries (special review-focused upcoming issues); after excluding those, only a handful of qualifying new Articles remained in that window. Paging further back into the 2026-02-15 to 2026-06-01 coverDate range (previously scanned less exhaustively) surfaced 257 qualifying candidates after basic filtering, from which 25 were selected prioritizing recency and coverage of the focus keywords.

eligibility_filters_applied: Review/systematic review/mini-review excluded; Erratum/Editorial excluded; microbe-strain-biology-centric papers excluded (structure/materials-focused polysaccharide papers from microbial sources would be retained per rule but none qualified in this run); coverDate within ~2 years
